decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of the original decision dated 12.09.2025 (Ref: 2025/00507/LBC).

Condition required to be imposed by Section 19(5) (a) of the Planning (Listed Building and Conservation Areas) Act, 1990 (as amended by section 91 of the Planning and Compensation Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the following approved drawings; other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:

394-12 A
394-08 B
394-10 C
394-07 C
394-09
394-11 C

To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing.

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to preserve the Ravenscourt And Starch Green Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - Full details, including physical samples, of all the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the building shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before any work commences on site. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of construction, details of the proposed all new and replacement windows and glazing shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The required details shall include a 1:20 scale elevation drawing of each window type showing the glazing pattern and 1:5 scale vertical and horizontal cross section drawings showing the upper and lower stiles, the meeting rails, the dimensions of the glazing, the profile and dimensions of the glazing bars and spacers (if any).  A 1:5 elevation drawing should be provided of any window details, particularly window horns (if any).   The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 6 - Prior to the commencement of construction, details of the proposed all new and replacement roof windows and rooflights shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The required details shall include a manufacturer's specification and illustration, together with a 1:20 scale elevation drawing showing the glazing pattern and 1:5 scale vertical and horizontal cross section drawings showing the location of the rooflight in relation to the roof structure and covering, the frames, the dimensions of the glazing, the profile and dimensions of the glazing bars and spacers (if any).  The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 7 - All existing historic features including, but not limited to, chimney pieces, plasterwork, architraves, panelling, doors, staircase balustrading shall remain undisturbed in their existing position and shall be fully protected during the course of works on site, unless specifically authorised otherwise on the drawings hereby approved.  The development and works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 8 - No soil stacks, soil vent pipes, plumbing, pipes, flues, vents or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building other than those shown on the drawings hereby approved.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 9 - Details of the following shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the commencement of works.  The works shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved:
a.)	A detailed method statement and schedule of works including the proposed demolition, construction, and how the existing historic fabric will be protected during the works. 

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building and conservation area, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved drawings) of the listed building consent reference: 2025/00507/LBC dated 12 September 2025 for the Erection of a rear extension at first floor level on top of the existing back addition, and installation of a window to the side elevation at first floor level to nos.58 and 60; demolition of existing conservatory and erection of a replacement single storey lean-to rear extension to the side of existing back addition to no.60; associated alterations. Amendment sought to extend the proposed single storey lean-to rear extension to the side of existing back addition to no.60.
